hint: An application immediately shows you the candidate's name and contacts.
emptyText: Publish a vacancy with a salary range and candidates will apply on their own.
pickText: Applications to your vacancies are listed on the left. Open one to see the candidate's profile and reply.
missingText: The link may be outdated. Pick an application from the list.

detail.revokedText: The card is anonymous again: name and contacts are hidden. The application stays in the list.

accept.title: Accept the application?
accept.text: The candidate will see that the application is accepted. Then reach out using the contacts on the card.

decline.title: Decline the application?
decline.text: The candidate will see the refusal. The decision cannot be undone.
